rationale: Lyc. ⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲥ = Sah. ⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ. Standard Manichaean title for the Light-Mind (Νοῦς), who awakens/raises souls. Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ (causative of ⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛ 'rise'). The Awakener has Five Sons corresponding to the five faculties of mind.

ⲣⲉϥ- + ⲥⲱϩⲉ/ⲥⲁϩⲟ ('to draw, pull') + ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ ('upward'). Soteriological agentive: one who draws souls upward. Preserves vertical-directional semantics. Each of the Five Sons of the Awakener is a drawer-upward.
Greek loanword μεθόριον 'frontier-region, boundary-zone.' Cosmological term for the limit/threshold. In context: 'in the boundary, until the last time.'
Manichaean technical term — the 'Living Law' as the cosmic ordering principle distinguishing good from evil (cf. line 6: 'the law of those who are good and those who are bitter').
Manichaean technical title: the Light-Mind (Νοῦς of Light), the fourth drawer-upward in this enumeration. Standard cosmological designation.
Lyc. ⲥⲉϫⲉ = Sah. ϣⲁϫⲉ 'word, speech.' With possessive prefix ⲡⲉϩ- ('his'). Used here for the divine utterance that gathers all lives.
